prompt: Cinematic wide shot in a dusty, dimly lit industrial workshop. An elderly man with weathered hands and graying hair, wearing worn-out work clothes, is meticulously organizing metal parts on a workbench. The warm, golden morning light streams through a high, grimy window, illuminating dancing dust motes, contrasting with the dark shadows of the background. The mood is one of quiet dignity and newfound purpose.

Low-angle street photography at 3 AM on a rainy Avenida Paulista. Jorge, a 60-year-old man with deep wrinkles and calloused hands, is kneeling on the wet asphalt, gathering scattered cardboard and plastic from his overturned cart. The background features the blurred, cold blue neon lights of luxury storefronts. He looks exhausted, his posture slumped. A group of wealthy, out-of-focus youths walks past in the distance. The lighting is harsh, cold, and moody, emphasizing the grit of the city.

A tense, intimate moment on a dark city park bench at dawn. Jorge sits under a dim, flickering streetlamp, rain drizzling down. He holds a leather bag in his lap, his expression conflicted and weary. Beside him is a cardboard box. In front of him, a younger, well-dressed man named Celso stands, looking at Jorge with a mix of desperation and sudden relief. The atmosphere is heavy and somber, captured in a medium close-up with soft, diffused morning light beginning to break through the gray clouds.

A warm, interior medium shot inside a cluttered but organized repair shop. Celso stands next to Jorge, who is now wearing a cleaner, albeit simple, work shirt. Jorge is carefully stacking metal components on a wooden shelf. The lighting is warm and amber-toned, highlighting the texture of the metal and the relief on Jorge's face. The composition focuses on their interaction, suggesting a quiet bond formed through shared respect. The background is filled with tools and machinery, creating a sense of stability and hard work.
